producer_report.summary: Retrying a retry now shows the reader the original request, not the "try again on <job>" phrase. In `earlier_attempt` (reading.rs), when the retried job's own request is a retry, Athena follows the chain back to the first non-retry request and redacts it. The retried job's findings are still the ones carried. The chain walk has a depth cap of 16 and a visited-job check. A broken or cyclic chain falls back to the last request reached. I split the prefix parsing into `retry_reference`. It now also refuses a bare "try again on" with no trailing space; before, that fell through as an ordinary request. New lifecycle test `retrying_a_retry_carries_the_original_request_redacted`: A is rejected, B ("try again on A") is rejected, then "try again on B". It asserts the third brief has A's original request, B's canary and not A's canary, and that the retry phrase is not carried as the earlier request. A and B get different verdict canaries. New unit test `a_bare_try_again_on_is_refused_and_a_named_job_is_found`. CHANGELOG has a `### Fixed` entry after Added. `cargo test --locked`, `cargo fmt --all` (it reformatted lifecycle.rs) and `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` all pass. I did not touch briefs.rs or the design docs.

checks_run.note: Applied formatting to lifecycle.rs. I did not run `cargo fmt --all --check` separately afterwards.
Whole workspace. Includes the lifecycle tests (29 passed), the athena-core unit tests (21 passed) and the athena-context reader-brief tests (15 passed).

open_issues: briefs.rs is listed as a deliverable but unchanged. The brief text still says "Its request:" for the carried original request, which reads acceptably.
The bare-refusal test covers `retry_reference`, not the full `earlier_attempt` path. Both live in reading.rs, so `cargo test --locked -p athena-core reading` finds it.
learnings: The bare-refusal check in `earlier_attempt` ran before any records access, so the unit test calls `retry_reference` and needs no Records value.
Before the change, a bare "try again on" with no trailing space fell through as a normal request, because the prefix slice failed. It is now refused.
A distinct verdict per verifier call needs a wrapper script that dispatches between two Scenario scripts. Scenario holds one fixed verdict.
